content.text:
* Complementary-input two-stage OTA with mirrored current summation.
.subckt DUT VINP VINN VOUT VDD VSS IBIAS
* Reference conversion and current distribution.
Xbn IBIAS IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=8 l=1 nf=1 m=1
Xbp_sink BP IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=8 l=1 nf=1 m=1
Xbp BP BP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=30 l=1 nf=1 m=1
* PMOS input pair, each drain terminated in an identical diode.
Xpt SP BP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=90 l=1 nf=1 m=1
Xpip PP VINP SP VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.15 nf=1 m=4
Xpin PN VINN SP VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.15 nf=1 m=4
Xplp Cplp PP VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=20 l=1 nf=1 m=1
Xcasplp PP PP Cplp VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=4
Xpln Cpln PN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=20 l=1 nf=1 m=1
Xcaspln PN PN Cpln VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=4
Xpfold Cpfold PP VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=20 l=1 nf=1 m=1
Xcaspfold PF PP Cpfold VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=4
Xpfd Cpfd PF VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=2
Xcaspfd PF PF Cpfd VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.15 nf=1 m=8
Xpfo Cpfo PF VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=2
Xcaspfo G1 PF Cpfo VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.15 nf=1 m=8
Xplo Cplo PN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=20 l=1 nf=1 m=1
Xcasplo G1 PN Cplo VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=4
* NMOS input pair and complementary current translation.
Xnt SN IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=24 l=1 nf=1 m=1
Xnip NP VINP SN VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=2
Xnin NN VINN SN VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=2
* High-side current sources and common-gate folding devices.
Xnloadp NP BP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=90 l=1 nf=1 m=1
Xnloadn NN BP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=90 l=1 nf=1 m=1
Xnfoldp PP BP NP VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=4
Xnfoldn PN BP NN VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=4
* Common-source second stage and series-zero Miller compensation.
Xout VOUT G1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=60 l=0.5 nf=1 m=1
Xoutbias VOUT BP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=90 l=1 nf=1 m=4
Rz G1 CZ 2000
Cc CZ VOUT 8.5p
.ends DUT
